selection.extended_controls_note: Additional morning-median bands: preceding volatility, trailing minute traded volume, adjacent gap and visible same-side queue. Sparse overlap is reported explicitly; weights and matched sample differ from the primary contrast.

replenishment.definition: 新增成交后同价深度维持、成熟量占比低于50%，对照高深度且成熟量占比至少80%；成熟指已存续一秒，午休从订单年龄扣除。
replenishment.extended_controls_note: Additional morning-median bands: preceding volatility, trailing minute traded volume, adjacent gap and visible same-side queue. Sparse overlap is reported explicitly; weights and matched sample differ from the primary contrast.

cancellation.definition: 撤单为过去5秒全簿撤单股数；近价容量指随后观察到的一档双边深度，含报价变化。匿名订单的数量相似只作为描述。
cancellation.extended_controls_note: Additional morning-median bands: preceding volatility, trailing minute traded volume, adjacent gap and visible same-side queue. Sparse overlap is reported explicitly; weights and matched sample differ from the primary contrast.

gap.mechanical_component: 小量限制在原最优档数量之内，单侧吃光后的中间价跳动与下一档距离存在规则决定的机械关系；主结果解释即时结构，后续漂移另行检验。
gap.definition: 按同频道连续同主动订单号聚合成交包；直到下一消息才确认包边界。小量阈值来自上午，结果描述即时价格变化。
gap.extended_controls_note: Additional morning-median bands: preceding volatility, trailing minute traded volume, adjacent gap and visible same-side queue. Sparse overlap is reported explicitly; weights and matched sample differ from the primary contrast.
